description: Change the title, the status or the instruction of one UI skill by its id. This is a partial update: a field you omit keeps its stored value. Use it to enable or disable a component without deleting it. A UI skill is NOT an agent skill (mba_list_agent_skills): an agent skill is instruction text that shapes what the agent says, a UI skill lets the agent send one kind of rich WhatsApp component and tells it when to send that component. Known limitation: component_type and flow_id cannot be changed - delete the UI skill and create a new one instead. A flow UI skill cannot be enabled until its flow is published.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

instruction.description: Tells the agent when to send this component, e.g. 'Send this when the customer asks to browse the catalog'.

status.description: Whether the agent may send this component. Only an enabled UI skill is available to the agent.

title.description: Human-readable name for the UI skill.

name: mba_update_ui_skill
title: Update a UI skill
